today_summary: GCM26 prints $4,351.6 on the 2026-09-15 chain, down $56.9 (-1.29%) from the $4,408.5 shelf that held two sessions - a 0.87sigma break that stopped $8.8 above the prior lower 1sigma band at $4,342.8. Near-spot net GEX collapsed to +156.0 from +231.7, a 33% cut to the stabilizing cushion after four sessions pinned at +233.6, +232.7, +231.7. Resistance is unchanged and stacked overhead at $4,500 (12,102 call OI), $4,725 (9,606) and $5,225 (9,407); the nearest real support is the $4,300 put shelf at 3,475 OI, just $51.6 below spot, with the top-3 put walls at $3,500 (5,546), $3,900 (3,860) and $4,000 (3,524) far out of play. Max pain $5,600 sits 28.7% above spot - a legacy artifact, not a magnet - and today's 1sigma band is $4,286.7-$4,416.5 on 23.67% ATM IV.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago spot was $4,438.6; it is $4,351.6 now, an $87.0 (-1.96%) grind lower that finally broke its shelf today. The structural story of the window was the 09-11 upside build - $5,225 +8,184 and $4,725 +8,171 in matched size - which lifted total call OI 201,767 to 219,333 (+17,566) against just +1,356 on the put side and dragged the cumulative gamma flip from $4,650 to $4,700. That combination widened the short-gamma gap beneath spot from $211 to $348 across the window: the flip rose $50 while spot fell $87. Today is the first session the cushion actually cracked - near-spot GEX had been frozen at +233.6, +232.7, +231.7 straight through the decline and printed +156.0 today, while call volume decayed 24,999 (09-11) to 15,129 to 9,127 and put volume rose to 2,838, taking the volume P/C from 0.13 to 0.31. Most telling, ATM IV is 23.67% against 23.69% five sessions ago - unchanged through a 2% drawdown, so nobody has paid up for downside yet even as near-spot put OI quietly built at $4,120 (+400), $4,000 (+273), $4,075 (+242) and $4,300 (+160).
what_changed: Spot broke the $4,408.5 two-session shelf to $4,351.6 (-$56.9, -1.29%), a 0.87sigma move that stopped $8.8 inside the prior lower 1sigma band
Near-spot net GEX cut to +156.0 from +231.7 (-33%) - first break in a cushion that held +233.6/+232.7/+231.7 through the entire decline
Volume P/C jumped 0.13 to 0.31 as put volume rose 2,003 to 2,838 and call volume decayed 15,129 to 9,127 - the first genuine downside engagement of the window
Put OI built near spot at $4,075 (+237 on 333 lots) and $4,000 (+152) while the $3,500 far wall sat frozen at 5,546 OI for a fifth straight session
Gamma flip held $4,700 as spot fell $56.9 - the short-gamma gap beneath spot widened to $348.4
Call OI bled at the top of the chain - $4,800 -276, $6,000 -226, $5,200 -169 - with the only meaningful build at $5,000 (+299)
prediction: Bias bearish below $4,416. The stabilizer that pinned this tape for four sessions just lost a third of its magnitude while spot sits $348.4 under the $4,700 gamma flip, and with IV unrepriced at 23.67% there is no vol premium cushioning a slide. The $4,300 put shelf at 3,475 OI is the first real test; beneath it the chain is thin until $4,200 (2,537) and $4,000 (3,524), while a reclaim of $4,416 negates the short and puts the $4,500 wall back in play.
